title: Full VRC Review Batch 002 — Content Classification Orders
mission: Move the tracker from preliminary VRCs toward full content-verified record cards by defining exact review orders for each source record.
boundary: This batch does not claim that record contents have been fully reviewed. It defines the review order, extraction fields, allowed conclusions, blocked conclusions and page upgrades for each selected record.
promotionRule: A preliminary VRC becomes a full VRC only when the record is opened, dated, classified, summarized, and limited by what it actually says.

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Tesla Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
extractFields: risk factors mentioning software, autonomy, data, AI, regulation or cybersecurity
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Tesla is a public-company infrastructure/data/mobility lane where supported by filing text
Specific risk factors can be cited only if present in the selected filing
blockedConclusions: content not present in the filing

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Oracle Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Oracle can be described through filing-supported cloud/database/enterprise lanes
Health or AI-infrastructure claims require specific filing text or separate records

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Microsoft Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Microsoft can be described through filing-supported cloud, enterprise and AI lanes
AI partnership claims must match filing language or separate source records

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Alphabet Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Alphabet can be described through filing-supported search, advertising, video, cloud and AI lanes
Platform power findings can cite filing-supported business descriptions and risk factors

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Meta Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Meta can be described through filing-supported social graph, advertising, AI and platform-risk lanes
Privacy or moderation claims need exact filing or transparency source support

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Amazon Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Amazon can be described through filing-supported AWS, commerce, logistics and devices lanes
Public-sector claims require contract records or disclosed filing language

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest NVIDIA Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: NVIDIA can be described through filing-supported AI compute and data-center lanes
Export-control conclusions require exact filing text or regulator records

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest Palantir Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: Palantir can be described through filing-supported public-sector/data-platform lanes
Agency use claims require agency-specific records

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: Latest BlackRock Form 10-K from official SEC EDGAR route
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: BlackRock can be described through filing-supported asset-management, risk-platform and stewardship lanes
Client-level or investment-intent claims require separate records

extractFields: policy date or last updated date
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: OpenAI policy claims can cite selected official policy text after classification
Data-use and deployment-boundary claims must match exact policy language
Specific public awards can be cited only when award results are selected and classified
No-award-found results can support missing-record status for that entity/date range
blockedConclusions: awards not returned by the search

reviewOrders.recordToOpen: DOJ official disclosure index and safe court-record route pages
allowedConclusionsAfterReview: DOJ official source route and disclosure categories can be cited after route review
Individual file contents require separate file-level VRCs

summary.nextStep: Open selected records and write content-verified VRC cards.
